profile.description: Med Life S.A., a private healthcare provider, provides integrated medical services through its clinics and hospitals in Romania. The company offers outpatient units and diagnostic imaging services; consultations with general practitioners and specialists; diagnostic imaging tests; day hospitalization services; hospitalization and surgical treatment services; medical and surgical specialties; maternal and child health dedicated services; and stem cell bank. It also provides laboratory services, such as biochemistry, pathological anatomy, molecular biology and genetics, hematology, immunology, microbiology, cytology, and toxicology; healthcare packages; a range of dental services; and fitness services and wellness facilities through the Sweat Concept network and Sanopass platform. In addition, the company is involved in the development of building projects; insurance broker; rental activities; and distribution and retail sale of pharmaceutical products in specialized stores. Med Life S.A. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Bucharest, Romania.
